items.title: 优化后的 45 站新记录

source.label: 概率 SSOT
source.sql: select checkpoint_id,station_id,event_date,stage,decision_at_utc,fresh_until_utc,posterior_version,json_extract(lineage_json,'$.p0_root_checkpoint_id') as p0_root_checkpoint_id,json_extract(lineage_json,'$.prediction_root_checkpoint_id') as prediction_root_checkpoint_id,json_extract(lineage_json,'$.forecast_revision_id') as forecast_revision_id,json_extract(lineage_json,'$.reaffirmation_of_checkpoint_id') as reaffirmation_of_checkpoint_id,json_extract(lineage_json,'$.p1_state_refresh_of_checkpoint_id') as p1_state_refresh_of_checkpoint_id,json_extract(lineage_json,'$.system_weights_json') as system_weights_json,json_extract(lineage_json,'$.run_init_utc_by_system_json') as run_init_utc_by_system_json,json_extract(lineage_json,'$.archive_query_at_utc_by_system_json') as archive_query_at_utc_by_system_json from basket_probability_envelope where station_id=? and event_date=? and state='COMMITTED' and decision_at_utc>=? and decision_at_utc<=? order by decision_at_utc
caveats: 113 份 P0-M 全部为无校准 artifact 路径，不能证明校准分支已修复。
这是运行短窗口验收，不是预测效果实验或晋级 OOS。
独立复核同一 decision 窗口后新增 14 份补写 P1，均无复制续期；389 为首次保存的样本数，decision/created_at 不能代替真实物化时间。
